nodes.label: wick_trap Archetype
nodes.rationale: The book's only fully validated champion edge: buys the BTC liquidity flush. Holdout PF 1.43 (n=70), V15 holdout 1.71, CPCV 15/15 positive, worst alternate history +$2,421. Survived the repaired engine bit-identically; carries all six sizing boosts live.

nodes.label: liquidity_compression (LC) Archetype
nodes.rationale: Real but thin second edge: holdout PF 1.14 with perfect train/holdout co-move, live PF 1.20-1.30 on track. Its starved backtest fire rate was later shown to be a store chop_score formula artifact; the real record is live+holdout.

nodes.label: order_block_retest Archetype
nodes.rationale: Validated third edge on the V15 store: holdout PF 2.08 (n=31), CPCV 15/15 median 1.39, OOS >= train, never tuned. Was dead live pre-07-17 due to chronic soft-gate penalties.

nodes.label: Lesson #54: Fusion Negative Predictive Power
nodes.rationale: Fusion score has NEGATIVE predictive power (Pearson r=-0.082 p=0.018, Spearman r=-0.122). All domain scores have near-zero correlation with PnL; replicated 4x including live (threshold-cleared trades PF 0.27 vs bypass-only 0.76). The edge comes from structural detection + hard gates, never fusion scoring. Never recommend fusion-based filters.

nodes.label: Boost-over-Filter Doctrine (Rules 7-10)
nodes.rationale: Empirical accept rates May 2026: sizing/exit boosts 2/2 accepted; hard/soft gates, mode flips, CMI tuning, direction flips 0/8. Filters fail via dedup-reshuffling, selection asymmetry (regime gates filter the wins), or gate-immune architecture. Default any new gate proposal to its boost equivalent; train AND OOS must improve together (Rule 9).

nodes.label: Temporal Mismatch Insight
nodes.rationale: YAML soft gates check the CURRENT bar's features but institutional confirmation (OI rising, selling subsiding) comes AFTER the pattern fires. Only concurrent-state features (e.g. funding rate) work in gates; OI/taker gates fail for sweeps/springs because whale confirmation is post-event.

nodes.label: Dedup-Reshuffling False Signal
nodes.rationale: System PnL gain WITHOUT target-archetype PnL gain = false signal: a gate shrinks the target archetype and dedup re-routes bars to other archetypes, so the system gain is routing, not the rule working. Validated with an oi_change_24h hard gate (system +$2,595, target -$5,465). Auto-reject, codified as Rule 7.

nodes.label: Signal Dedup (best_per_direction)
nodes.rationale: Deployed dedup mode: max 1 long + 1 short signal per bar. Its bar re-routing behavior is the mechanism behind the dedup-reshuffling false-signal failure mode.

nodes.label: Smart Exits V2
nodes.rationale: Composite invalidation (5-feature, threshold 4/5), distress half-exit, and chop-aware trailing in exit_logic.py. Threshold must be 4/5 not 3/5: at 3/5 the exits fired 105x, all losses (-$55K); at 4/5 only 23 selective exits, net positive. Chop-aware trailing is always positive (volatility-adaptive stops, Clare et al. 2013).

nodes.label: Whale Conflict Penalty
nodes.rationale: Direction-aware 4-signal institutional data check run before fusion. Must be light (5% per signal) - 10% per signal killed $54K from wick_trap. Must keep the perp OI witness: swapping to CME daily OI cost -$24.7K because the -3% threshold was calibrated to the 4h perp distribution (semantics mismatch, not data quality).

nodes.label: CMI Regime System
nodes.rationale: Composite market-instability regime scoring (risk_temperature, instability, crisis_prob) driving the dynamic fusion threshold. Must stay orthogonal to archetype fusion to prevent double-counting/overfitting; regime exit scaling is disabled (tested net negative); three independent files compute CMI and only the backtester reads config, so weight changes must be grepped across all three.

nodes.label: Standing Orders
nodes.rationale: NEVER turn off bypass_threshold (data collection mode mandatory); NEVER disable any archetype (all 17 stay enabled for maximum live signal data); NEVER make production config/code changes without explicit user approval; always ask before deploy - prior approvals do not carry forward.

nodes.label: bypass_threshold Data-Collection Mode
nodes.rationale: Live setting where sub-threshold signals still trade so the book harvests forward data; the dynamic threshold is computed and logged but not gated on. Turning it off would have deleted all 9 live winners while keeping the 5 worst losers in the June forensic.

nodes.label: derivatives_heat CMI Component
nodes.rationale: OI/funding/taker-based CMI component wired but DISABLED (weight 0%) pending 3+ years of OI data: enabling redistributed CMI weights and changed thresholds for ALL bars including 2020-21 with no OI data; at 10% weight it showed the overfit signature (+OOS, -train).
